prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game material atlas for a cinematic Scottish Highland coastal speedboat adventure. Create one square 2048x2048 image divided into an exact 4 by 4 grid of equal square material cells, absolutely no gutters, borders, labels or text. Each cell is a flat orthographic surface texture, seamless-looking edges, neutral diffuse lighting, no perspective, no directional shadows. Row 1 left to right: ivory marine enamel with subtle fine wear; warm honey teak decking with narrow dark caulk seams running vertically; cognac tan stitched leather upholstery; charcoal fine-grained marine rubber. Row 2: lightly brushed aged silver metal; layered grey Highland sedimentary rock with fine cracks; muted olive moss on stone; dense dark Scots pine needle foliage. Row 3: weathered grey-brown dock planks vertical; purple heather and olive coastal scrub close texture; damp dark slate rock; pale weathered sandstone masonry with staggered blocks. Row 4: irregular sea foam lace white on black; soft fine spray droplets white on black fading to black at all edges; mottled sea-green water detail; fine rope fibres light beige vertical. Realistic restrained rich textures, coherent natural material scale, subtle wear, high detail. No objects, logos, text, watermarks, UI, decorative frame or lighting gradients.
usage: Local material atlas. Cells cropped independently at runtime; foam and spray interpreted as linear masks.
